error.comment: A build tool, emulator, or extension failure, sent to 8bitworkshop.com/error.php. Gated on VS Code's telemetry.telemetryLevel through env.createTelemetryLogger; nothing is sent when telemetry is off. Uncaught errors from this extension use the same sender.

source.comment: Where the failure came from: vscode, worker, emu, or ide.

msg.comment: Error message, cleaned by VS Code and truncated to 2000 characters.

stack.comment: Stack trace, with user paths scrubbed by VS Code, truncated to 2000 characters.

platform.comment: Platform id, for example nes or c64.

tool.comment: Build tool id, for example cc65 or dasm.

window.comment: Window or workspace identifier, when provided.
